requests.why: my little table wobbles every time I hammer on it, and I keep dropping tools in the grass

requests.size: about 3 units wide, 1.3 tall to the tabletop, 1.4 deep (Odyssey Jr. is about 2 units tall)
requests.materials: warm honey-colored wood, dark metal vise, red-handled tools

place.near: the middle of the yard, replacing the old workbench

requests.label: Workbench
requests.interactive: When a visitor clicks it, the lantern flickers on and Odyssey Jr. says something about what he's building.
